approval_ref: The user asked to use DeepSeek V4.1 Flash as the reference and then compare it with a Pro model while retaining the same frozen CIRP input scope.
notes: Expose the official DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model ID and show V4.1 Pro as unavailable.
Block deepseek-v4-pro because the provider currently routes it to V4.1 Flash, which cannot produce an independent comparison.
Keep historical deepseek-v4-flash profiles readable by normalizing the accepted alias for new profiles without rewriting old evaluation or call rows.
Reject the transitional Pro alias and unknown DeepSeek model IDs before HTTP.
Use only synthetic offline configuration tests; the separately authorized live benchmark is operational validation, not an acceptance-test side effect.
title: Select exact DeepSeek Flash and block false Pro comparisons
objective: Freeze the exact available DeepSeek V4.1 Flash profile, preserve historical aliases and prevent a routed Flash alias from being recorded as an independent Pro comparison.
